_note: Canned refresh of the stale Gemini Models note. Facts checked on 10 November 2026; re-check before the talk.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.summary: Google's Gemini API page listing deprecation and shutdown schedules for stable and preview models. It recommends 3.5 Flash-Lite or 3.8 Flash for new projects.
sources.author: Google AI for Developers

concept.title: Gemini Models
concept.description: Which Gemini model IDs to use for agents and note-taking work.
concept.summary: Model IDs change every few months, so this note has a short shelf life. As of November 2026 the current stable Flash model is gemini-3.8-flash, and Google points new projects to 3.8 Flash or 3.5 Flash-Lite. Older Flash IDs are being retired or routed to newer models.
key_points: Default for agents and summarising: gemini-3.8-flash, generally available since 2 September 2026.
Google recommends 3.5 Flash-Lite or 3.8 Flash for new projects.
Pin an exact model ID in code and re-check the deprecations page before a demo.
